viaje.start_desc: A real process. Three cards each day: morning, midday and night. No shortcuts.
viaje.start_how_1: 20 days with yourself. A process, not a game. Go at your pace, no skipping steps.
viaje.start_how_2: Each day, three cards: morning, midday and night. Each one opens at its hour.
viaje.start_how_3: You move through four phases: Awaken, Descend, Cross and Return.
viaje.start_how_4: From each card you keep one word. At the end you'll have the full map of your journey.
viaje.umbral_1: Standing up, write: «What I fear most to find here is…»
viaje.umbral_2: Read out loud the Descend card that shook you most.
viaje.umbral_3: Write an excuse you've used your whole life. Cross it out.

paso.intro_desc: PASO is a short test that reveals how you move through life: how you decide, how you relate, how you keep your pace, and how you read the terrain before stepping on it.
paso.intro_how: You'll see 28 groups of four phrases. In each one, mark the one that represents you MOST and the one that represents you LEAST. There are no right or wrong answers.
paso.test_prompt: Mark the phrase that represents you MOST and the one that represents you LEAST.
paso.que_es_intro: PASO doesn't tell you who you are. It looks at how you walk through life through four ways of moving. None is better than another: we all carry the four, in different measure.
paso.que_es_P: How you decide and move forward: the drive to choose a direction and push toward it.
paso.que_es_A: How you relate: how much you walk with others and need their company.
paso.que_es_S: How you hold your pace: the calm and steadiness to keep going.
paso.que_es_O: How you read the terrain: how much you observe and weigh before taking the step.
paso.curva_hint: The higher the zone, the more pronounced that way of walking. The balance line is the neutral point.
paso.firma_desc: Your exact way of walking. Each axis sits in its zone, from 1 (slight) to 7 (very pronounced). Zone 4 is balance.
paso.separas_gap: The biggest gap is in «{dim}». It's the distance between what you show on the outside and the terrain you carry inside.
paso.dir_exige: you push yourself more than comes naturally
paso.dir_esconde: you hold back more than you show
paso.book: The book that resonates most with you
paso.nota_espejo: PASO isn't a scientific test or a diagnosis. It's a mirror: what your answers draw, a direction to look at yourself. It doesn't say who you are, but how you walk today — and that can always change.
paso.cta_account: Create a free account to save your result and keep exploring the method.
paso.pdf_hint: A PDF will be created and the menu to save or share it will open.
paso.share_text: My way of walking in PASO: “{patron}”. Discover yours:
paso.pdf_footer: Discover how you walk at www.ikigaier.com
